facts.sentence: On Tuesday, Nov 17, 1,592 of the 1,691 elevators AGSIST reads with the same delivery month both days posted a lower cash corn bid than Monday, 87 a higher one; 170 changed their basis, 28 weaker and 142 stronger.
facts.detail: 12 unchanged; median change 3½¢ lower. Biggest state move: Nebraska, 4¢ lower (239 elevators).
facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-11-17 vs 2026-11-16, same board, crop and delivery period
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)
